text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
First visit! ♪ First visit! ♪ The first shrine
visit of
the new year! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna drink some amazake and eat
some fried
squid! Oh, and I gotta gulp
down some cold
water!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you don't know? Shrines always
have those
little fountains!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And they got cups and everything! But
it's hard to
hold them 'cause they've got
these weird, long
handles.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! But the water is so nice
and cold!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Let's go write down our
wishes!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've got a ton of wishes. First is "I wanna
enter the
Arima Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And also "I wanna eat tasty carrots!" and
"I wanna
get first place a lot!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna become really fast!" and "I
wanna
become really strong!" and "I
wanna have a lot of
fun!" and...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Just one? Mmm... It's too hard to pick!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What would you write if you were me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Haru Urara is set on entering
the
Arima Kinen. Which means it'd be
good for her to
wish for...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh! Health does come first! I can't race if I'm not feeling well!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But I'm always plenty healthy and full of
energy
already! So you want me to feel
even better?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! One... Actually...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ura, Ura, Ura, Ura! Uraaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow, saying "Ura, Ura" while I run is so
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not the way I imagined it, but Haru
Urara
becomes even more energetic than
before.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Level up! That sounds so cool!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I know how to level up! I saw it
on TV!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Of course! Watch this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
DA, DA, DA, DUUUN! Haru Urara
leveled up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I feel stronger already! Mhm, I'm
just gonna
keep leveling up like this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
DA, DA, DA, DUUUN! DA, DA, DA,
DUUUN!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I've gotten so much stronger! I
think!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe a modest amount
self-delusion has
its uses. I'll just leave
her to it.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh, the big leagues!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uh, what are those?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? On track? Which track? What
kind of pro?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: OH! A racing track!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I get it! I'm gonna be a racing track pro!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara seems ready to go. I'm sure
she's off
to hone her unique skills.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I've finished writing my wish!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What?! Training, already?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I love running, but... look at all these
stalls!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Can't we stay for a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I do, but I... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You mean I have to start training now if I wanna compete?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I am taking it seriously! I'm always running my hardest, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I always go full force till I hear the
whistle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but worry. It sounds like
Haru Urara
thinks the Arima Kinen is just
a normal race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So far she's just been racing for fun, but
now
results are actually going to be
important if she
wants to qualify for the
graded races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We need to work on her form and times
as well as
prep her on how to run in
graded races.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why would I? I love running! Hey, can
we do
another lap around the shrine?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess her listening to what I have to
say is a
measure of progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, our next goal is the Negishi
Stakes!
